title: 把 Sentences in Chinese: HSK 3 Grammar with Examples
description: How to use 把 (bǎ) in Chinese: the word order, why the verb needs something after it, negatives with 没有 and 别, and 12 HSK 3 example sentences.
lede: 把 (bǎ) moves the object in front of the verb, so the sentence can say what happened to it: where it went, what state it ended up in, or whether the action was finished. It is one of the key grammar points of HSK 3.

paras: Subject + 把 + object + verb + something else.

In a normal sentence the object comes after the verb. With 把, it comes before the verb, and the end of the sentence tells you the result. Compare 我吃了苹果 (I ate an apple) with 我把苹果吃了 (I ate the apple, and now it is gone).

examples.en: I ate the apple (it's gone now).

paras: The most common mistake with 把 is to end the sentence on a bare verb. 我把作业做 is not a complete sentence. After the verb, add a result such as 完 or 坏, a direction such as 走, a place with 在, a person with 给, or a short 一下.
The object of 把 is usually something specific that both speakers know about: the door, this book, my computer.

examples.zh: 妹妹把我的电脑用坏了。
examples.py: Mèimei bǎ wǒ de diànnǎo yònghuài le.
examples.en: My little sister broke my computer.

sections.h2: Putting things somewhere, giving things to someone
paras: 把 is the natural way to say where you put something (verb + 在 + place) or who you give it to (verb + 给 + person). Requests often start with 请.

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ shǒujī fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
examples.en: Please put your phone on the table.

examples.py: Nǐ bǎ zhè běn shū gěi wǒ ba.

examples.zh: 我把这件事告诉妈妈了。
examples.py: Wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì gàosu māma le.

paras: To say something didn't happen, put 没有 before 把, not before the verb. To tell someone not to do it, use 别 or 不要, also before 把.

examples.py: Bié bǎ dōngxi fàng zài zhèr.

examples.zh: 你不要把这件事告诉他。
examples.py: Nǐ búyào bǎ zhè jiàn shì gàosu tā.

worksheet.title: 把 Sentences Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 把 sentences worksheet for HSK 3: 19 exercises (choose the word after the verb, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 在, 给 or 完
exercises.instructions: Write 在, 给 or 完 after the verb. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: Give this phone back to him.
He has finished reading that book.

items.zh: 妈妈把水果放＿＿桌子上了。
items.en: Mum put the fruit on the table.
I lent the money to a friend.
Have you finished washing the clothes?
Don't leave your bag by the door.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence with 把.

items.en: Please put the book on the table.
My older brother gave me his computer.
answers: 哥哥把他的电脑送给我了。

items.en: Give your room a quick clean.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: He didn't turn off the light.
Please put your phone in your bag.
